findings.location: inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_pcb: J1 pads 1 and 2 and their F.Cu routing
findings.mechanism: J1.1 connects to R1's series-only side. J1.2 connects directly to R1.2 and C1.1, placing the shunt capacitor on the contractual input instead of the filtered output.
findings.reasoning: Both saved copper tracing and the exported schematic establish the reversed connection. With an ideal source driving contractual input J1.2 and an unloaded output at J1.1, resistor current is zero and V(J1.1)/V(J1.2)=1; the intended RC output filtering is absent under those explicit assumptions. Clean ERC/DRC and schematic parity cannot detect this contract mismatch because schematic and PCB share the same reversal.
findings.title: J1 input and filtered-output pins are reversed
